meta.achieved_reward_def: sum_t gamma^t r(cube(s_{t+1})) over real steps, obs units, from the recorded rollout track

t3.note: oracle = max over the two dedicated single-region arms; chose-correct = larger unweighted discounted dwell in the occupancy-correct region

t5.note: lambda=0 = the no-penalty control pricing the detour; deflection = time_in_B(lam)/time_in_B(0)

t6.note: controls: random-z (floor) + best-candidate (GPI over the 5 native conditionings scored at z_tilde) -- the second separates 'learned z~' from 'any reasonable policy scores'
